The '''Cerenia system''' was on the [[Harrin Trade Corridor]], between the [[Brevost system/Legends|Brevost system]] and [[Lazerian system/Legends|Lazerian system]].<ref name="TSK" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ruten]].<ref name="OPS" />
